arxiv-1904-01011.title: Oriented suspension mechanics with applications to flow linear dichrosim spectroscopy and pathogen detection
arxiv-1904-01011.creator: G. Cupples, D. J. Smith, M. R. Hicks, R. J. Dyson
arxiv-1904-01011.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by G. Cupples, D. J. Smith, M. R. Hicks, R. J. Dyson. Flow linear dichroism is a biophysical spectroscopic technique that exploits the shear-induced alignment of elongated particles in suspension. Motivated by the broad aim of optimising the sensitivity of this technique, and more specifically by a handheld synthetic biotechnology prototype for waterborne-pathogen detection, a model of steady and oscillating pressure-driven channel flow and orientation dynamics of a suspension of slender microscopic fibres is developed.

arxiv-2205-04653.title: Energy storage under high-rate compression of single crystal tantalum
arxiv-2205-04653.creator: J. C. Stimac, N. Bertin, J. K. Mason, V. V. Bulatov
arxiv-2205-04653.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by J. C. Stimac, N. Bertin, J. K. Mason, V. V. Bulatov. When a material is plastically deformed the majority of mechanical work is dissipated as heat, and the fraction of plastic work converted into heat is known as the Taylor-Quinney coefficient (TQC). Large-scale molecular dynamics simulations were performed of high strain rate compression of single-crystal tantalum, and the resulting integral and differential TQC values are reported up to true strains of 1.0 1.0 .

arxiv-2207-02415.title: Moiré exciton condensate: nonlinear Dirac point, broken-symmetry Bloch waves and unusual optical selection rules
arxiv-2207-02415.creator: Sha Deng, Yichen Chu, Qizhong Zhu
arxiv-2207-02415.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sha Deng, Yichen Chu, Qizhong Zhu. Moiré exciton features tunable Dirac dispersion and spatially dependent optical selection rules. With the long lifetime due to its interlayer nature, it is promising to realize a Bose-Einstein condensation of moiré excitons. Here we study the properties of moiré exciton condensate within the mean-field theory, with special focus on exciton-exciton interaction effect on the nonlinear Bloch band and Bloch waves of exciton condensate in moiré potential.

Utilizing the imaging data of the Hyper Suprime-Cam Subaru Strategic Program (HSC-SSP), we measure the flux fraction of tidal features ( f tidal f_{\rm tidal} ) in 2649 ETGs with stellar mass M ∗ > 10 11 ​ M ⊙ M_{*}>10^{11}M_{\odot} and redshift 0.

arxiv-2305-03011.title: Algebraic Structures Behind the Yang-Baxterization Process
arxiv-2305-03011.creator: Cansu Özdemir a , and Ilmar Gahramanov b,c,d,e
arxiv-2305-03011.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Cansu Özdemir a , and Ilmar Gahramanov b,c,d,e. We review the Yang-Baxterization process of braid group representations. We discuss the corresponding n n -CB algebras in the Yang-Baxterization process. We present diagrams of the relations for the 4 4 -CB algebras. These relations are illustrated using the isomorphism between the general free algebra generated by { 1 } \{1\} , { E i } \{E_{i}\} , and { G i } \{G_{i}\} and Kauffman’s tangle algebra.

arxiv-2408-04096.description: Abstract Deriving high quality lightcuves for asteroids and other periodic sources from survey data is challenging due to many factors, including the sparsely sampled observational record and diurnal aliasing which is a signature imparted into the periodic signal of a source that is a function of the observing schedule of ground-based telescopes.

arxiv-2507-16358.title: A note on the boundary dynamics of holomorphic iterated function systems
arxiv-2507-16358.creator: Argyrios Christodoulou
arxiv-2507-16358.description: Abstract . We consider the boundary dynamics of iterated function systems of holomorphic self-maps of the unit disc. Our main result provides a sufficient condition which guarantees that the dynamical behaviour of a left iterated function system in the interior of the unit disc can be extended to the boundary.

arxiv-2507-20892.title: PixelNav: Towards Model-based Vision-Only Navigation with Topological Graphs
arxiv-2507-20892.creator: Sergey Bakulin, Timur Akhtyamov, Denis Fatykhov, German Devchich, Gonzalo Ferrer
arxiv-2507-20892.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sergey Bakulin, Timur Akhtyamov, Denis Fatykhov, German Devchich, Gonzalo Ferrer. This work proposes a novel hybrid approach for vision-only navigation of mobile robots, which combines advances of both deep learning approaches and classical model-based planning algorithms. Today, purely data-driven end-to-end models are dominant solutions to this problem. Despite advantages such as flexibility and adaptability, the requirement of a large amount of training data and limited interpretability are the main bottlenecks for their practical applications.

pmc-13072289.creator: Yingfeng Wan, Jingwei Zhang, Liheng Bian, Xiaoxiao Tan, Ting Chen, Guohua Xi, Ya Hua, Aditya S. Pandey, Richard F. Keep, Sravanthi Koduri
pmc-13072289.description: Stroke, a leading cause of mortality and long-term disability, induces complex cascades of oxidative stress and neuroinflammation that exacerbate brain injury. pmc-13360430.title: Green-synthesized LaOCl/ZnO heterojunction for efficient photocatalytic degradation of methyl orange
pmc-13360430.creator: Hoai Phuong Nguyen Thi, Minh Thu Ngo Thi, Trong Hieu Do, Van Hai Nguyen, Trung Hieu Vu, Cong Danh Doan, Duong Duc La
pmc-13360430.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). A novel LaOCl/ZnO photocatalyst was synthesized via a Terminalia catappa-assisted coprecipitation route for methyl orange (MO) degradation under simulated sunlight. The leaf extract acted as a green structure-directing medium that promoted nucleation, stabilization, particle dispersion, and composite formation. XRD, EDS, TEM mapping, and XPS confirmed the coexistence of crystalline ZnO and LaOCl with Zn, O, La, and Cl distributed in the composite. The optimal material was obtained at a La/Zn molar ratio of 20% and 500 °C calcination.
